dmzBalance.fact: MW4 launches with 33 weapons shared by Multiplayer and DMZ (Warzone joins in Season 1): 24 primaries, 8 secondaries (4 pistols, 4 launchers) and 1 melee knife.

The official DMZ guide says the Gunsmith Buy New Weapon screen shows all 32 launch weapons in 8 classes: AR 8, SMG 5, Shotgun 2, LMG 3, Marksman 3, Sniper 3, Pistol 4, Launcher 4. The knife is not in that count, so 32 + 1 melee = 33. In-game footage described by GamerFuzion also shows a Melee tab on that screen.
Per the official AMA (as reported by GamerFuzion), DMZ has its own damage tuning. It is close to Warzone but built around DMZ items such as plate carriers. No source gives per-weapon DMZ numbers.
Infinity Ward said there are currently no armor-piercing rounds or a similar field upgrade in DMZ (AMA answer).
Tac Sprint is on by default in DMZ. In Multiplayer it sits on the Blood Rush perk.

Per the 9 Oct AMA (GamerFuzion summary), weapon levels, attachment unlocks and camo progress are shared between modes. The right to buy a gun in the DMZ Gunsmith is not shared: you need that gun's Weapon Manual. (The 19 Oct arsenal blog words this differently; see gaps.)
Early Access update of 20 Oct: no weapon balance changes. DMZ fixes include the ISO Nightshade Apex Attachment not working as intended in DMZ.

Launch patch notes (21 Oct): a deep balance pass on all weapons since the Beta. SMGs are stronger at close to mid range, one-shot weapons get flinch and damage tuning, and attachments were retuned. No numbers are given and nothing is marked DMZ-only.
DMZ Radar reports that on 28 Sep Infinity Ward said launch TTK is close to Beta Weekend Two, SMGs get buffs and assault rifles stay as they are. This is second-hand; the original post was not saved.

Other weapon fixes on 20-21 Oct: the Rezi 12 showed 0.00 TTK in the Firing Range; the Gunsmith Attachment menu could stay on screen during deployment; Switch 2 players could not buy saved Blueprint changes.
Open DMZ known issues on the official Trello (21 Oct): the Free Loadout can load you in with no weapons; applying some camos or reticles in the DMZ Gunsmith can take DMZ Cash.
Gunsmith builds take at most 5 attachments plus a free Apex slot. Guns found in Hajin can have up to 8 attachments, and boss weapons can go past five.

Each attachment slot costs more than the last (official). DMZ Radar lists 1,000 / 5,000 / 10,000 / 25,000 / 50,000. DMZ Codex shows a Han 86 cart: slot 1 (1,000) + slot 2 (5,000) + drum (15,000) + suppressor (15,000) = 36,000.

Full builds are expensive: Destructoid says a Manual gun with five attachments runs past six digits, and PC Gamer paid over $90,000 for one gun. DMZ Radar cites an official M4 example of 99,987 after a 5% discount.
Weapons wear down. Damaged guns still work but handle worse.

Hajin has four AI tiers: Grunts, Armored soldiers, Armored soldiers with gas masks and Faceless armored soldiers. CODMunity says Commanders (Colossus, Deathstalker and a battle tank) shrug off many standard weapons. The official weapon text says launchers are for vehicles and Killstreaks, and the Signal 50 Inferno Apex adds damage to vehicles and Killstreaks. No source says which gun works best on Commanders.

In DMZ you may carry two primaries, two secondaries or one of each, plus a melee weapon; a Weapon Backpack (found or 3D printed) lets you bring more. DMZ Radar notes the 3D Printer makes gear, not guns.

access.name: Free Loadout (any gun)
access.how: Choose the Free Loadout at Ready Up for basic gear and keep it if you extract. One guide says it gives a random primary plus a Sang 9mm. Known issue (21 Oct): some players load in with no weapons.

access.name: Gunsmith base weapon (any gun)
access.how: The Gunsmith opens at DMZ level 10. Extract with a gun's Weapon Manual, then buy that base gun with DMZ Cash; locked guns tell you to extract the manual. Then pay for slots and attachments (attachments unlock by weapon level). Note: the 19 Oct arsenal blog reads as if MP or DMZ unlocks are enough; DMZ Codex flags this conflict.
access.price: About 3,500 to 24,000 by gun in the DMZ Codex menu table (SMGs listed at 3,000 from an older, unconfirmed capture); a Gunsmith Discount (5% per DMZ Codex) unlocks through DMZ progression at the 3D Printer

access.name: Weapon Manuals
access.how: Look in military containers and safes; Lieutenants can also drop rare manuals. Extracting one unlocks that gun for purchase and pays 5,000 DMZ Cash. Manuals seen so far include Mosin-Nagant, X-58 Nyx and Patriot XMR. Whether the unlock is shared with your squad is unconfirmed.

access.name: Owned blueprints (the "free at level 10" guns)
access.how: Not a gift for everyone. Once the Gunsmith opens at level 10, each blueprint you already own can be taken once for free and goes to your Stash. Lose it and you can rebuy it at a discount. Owned via the Vault Edition (Kastov 762 Voltspine, ISO Nightshade La Sombra Venenosa, Rezi 12 Shattered Code, Oris 8.6 Volt-Edge, Combat Knife Sombra Besada), the digital pre-order (Inner Circuit M4) or as the reward for completing the Beta (Beta Forged Han 86).
access.price: Free once (the Inner Circuit M4 showed $88,075 crossed out)

access.name: Vendor
access.how: Unlocks at DMZ level 5. Sells weapons for DMZ Cash; stock refreshes now and then, and Vendor upgrades from the 3D Printer add more options.
access.price: Varies (a Rare Mosin-Nagant was offered at 32,750)

access.name: Loot in Hajin
access.how: From enemies, Lieutenants, killed players, military containers in Police Stations and Compounds, supply drops and vaults. Rarity and attachments are random; higher threat zones give better guns. A gun you extract can go into the Gunsmith as a single copy, but if you lose it that model stays locked.

access.name: Lieutenant signature weapons
access.how: Each Lieutenant's own weapon is a rare drop on the kill. If it does not drop, check the body for a key to their loot room, where it can usually be found. Drops are random.

gaps: Separate DMZ balance: the only non-Reddit source is the AMA summary (own damage tuning, close to Warzone, built around plate carriers). No official patch note or blog gives DMZ-only weapon numbers or says a gun was tuned only for DMZ.
Stopping Power rounds: no non-Reddit page was found saying this field upgrade is missing from DMZ. Only the no-AP-rounds answer was found.

Gunsmith prices were not found for the Axion, Oden, Cronen Squall, any pistol or any launcher. The SMG price (3,000) comes from an earlier capture and is unconfirmed. The official M4 example (about 5,000) and the menu price (6,250) differ.
Free Loadout contents (random primary plus Sang 9mm) come from one guide (Game8). Activision only says basic gear.

Purchase rule conflict: the 9 Oct FOB guide and the AMA say a Weapon Manual is needed, but the 19 Oct arsenal blog says MP or DMZ unlocks can be bought with DMZ Cash. In-game footage (via GamerFuzion) shows locked guns asking for the manual.
Whether a Weapon Manual unlock is shared with the squad is unconfirmed.

Lieutenant signature weapons: AllThingsHow sits behind a Cloudflare check, so only WebFetch summaries were saved (the original and a checker re-read; both give the same names and values), not the page itself. The Dreadnought value conflicts (16K vs $8,000). The Incisor base (MAR-9) comes from AllThingsHow only. Paektu and Widowmaker are named only by AllThingsHow; Revenant, The Kraken and High Roller's Fortune are marked unconfirmed by DMZ Codex.
Lieutenant locations differ between sites, for example Bale: Insider Gaming says Re-Education Center, CODMunity says the Tank Depot at Chang-san. Not checked further here.
Activision never says outright that the Vault Edition Combat Knife is the FSS Carbon Edge 1095. DMZ Codex treats them as one.

No DMZ meta or loadout article was found from Dexerto, CharlieIntel (search page loads by script), GameRant, Sportskeeda or Dot Esports (Dot Esports and esports.gg returned 403). IGN, Eurogamer, Polygon and VG247 were skipped because they block requests. DMZ Codex has no meta list.

Most DMZ meta lists copy each other: LoadoutVault averages four lists, DMZ Radar matches the WZStats DMZ PvP list tier for tier, and Destructoid is almost the same as Skycoach. CODMunity pick rates have no stated method. None cite in-game DMZ stats. Roughly three independent DMZ lists remain (CODMunity, WZStats, Skycoach/Destructoid).
The official launch blog gives two different unlock levels for some guns (table vs stat block, e.g. VEL 46 at 5 or 13). These are Multiplayer player levels.
The wiki detail "Named pre launch: 13" could not be checked against any saved page.

Slot pricing conflict: CODMunity (its beginner guide and its recap of the DMZ Progression trailer, raw/codmunity-dmz-news.html) says each new attachment slot costs 1,000, but the official DMZ guide says each slot costs more than the last (DMZ Radar: 1,000 / 5,000 / 10,000 / 25,000 / 50,000).

Pre-1 Sep 2026 sources dropped: PixelNitro, Dexerto (tier list and all-weapons page), Nintendo Life, FandomWire and Gameshorizon. No post-launch replacement was fetched for the Multiplayer Beta lists.

listCheck.verdict: The 33 names and 9 classes in existing-weapons.json match the official launch blog and launch patch notes.
listCheck.count: Both numbers are right. 33 is the whole game (24 primaries + 8 secondaries + 1 knife). The official DMZ guide counts 32 on the Gunsmith Buy New Weapon screen, without the knife (in-game footage also shows a Melee tab there). Suggest the line read: 33 weapons (32 guns and launchers + 1 knife), and drop the bare "Weapons at launch: 32".
listCheck.dreadnought: Not a separate launch weapon. It is Bale's Legendary Lieutenant version of the Type 73 with a 100-round box mag. Take it out of the launch-weapon Named examples, or label it as a Lieutenant variant.
listCheck.balance_wording: Change "separate from MP and Warzone" to: DMZ has its own damage tuning, close to Warzone, built around plate carriers; weapon levels and attachments are shared across modes. The wiki currently cites Reddit and YouTube for this; GamerFuzion's AMA summary is a non-Reddit source.
listCheck.prices: Menu prices on DMZ Codex differ from the wiki: Han 86 is 6,000 (wiki says 4,750, a discounted trailer price), M4 is 6,250 (official example about 5,000). The ISO 3,000 is from an earlier capture and is unconfirmed.
